thread:
maria: Heads-up — we need to shift today's all-hands agenda by ~10min; AV found a recorder config issue. Can leadership be on standby? Recording might start late. @ceo_jen @diego

alex: copy. what's failing?

maria: OBS keeps dropping frames after ~45m, encoder errors in logs: `obs: encoder_error: nvenc_overflow`. AV team testing RTMP fallback to Zoom bridge while we bring up backup NVR.

tim: if recording starts late can we still keep the 30m Q&A? we can trim internal updates.

jordan: I'll move my slides to the end and skip the live demo if needed. no prob.

samir: @maria i can spin up a local NVR and start a backup recording. point me to the mount for media.

maria: spinning NVR now, mounting to `nvr-03:/mnt/recordings`. also, leadership decision needed — do we run full roadmap deep-dive or a short high-level version?

ceo_jen: go high-level only. postpone detailed roadmap walkthrough to next week. prioritize Q&A so the team gets time with execs.

alex: noted — updating agenda and the calendar invites now (will post new start time in ~2m).

maria: NVR backup recording started (local). OBS still glitchy but RTMP fallback is live; stream viewers should be fine, audio stable.

eng_oncall: pasting recent tail of obs logs for context: ```2026-03-23T17:02:11Z obs: dropped_frames=1200 encoder_temp=92C nvenc_status=overflow``` rerouting encoding off the NUC GPU to spare host to avoid thermal throttling.

samir: local NVR captured ~8min of warmup fine, I'll rsync to S3 after the meeting and set retention to 90 days.

tim: quick Q for leadership during Q&A: any update on Dedicated capacity SLA changes? will there be impact to current customers?

ceo_jen: short answer: yes for new contracts — tightening latency SLOs and adding a higher-tier SLA. existing customers are grandfathered for 6 months; we will publish a PRD and FAQ after today's all-hands.

alex: added that note to the live doc: https://docs.redwood/in/allhands/2026-03-23-notes — flagging product for PRD link.

maria: recording officially marked started at 09:12 PT. stream is live. thanks everyone :thumbsup: please ping here if anything degrades.

jordan: if anyone hits upload or post-process issues, DM me; I'll help with transcoding and clipping after the session.

maria: postmortem action items: 1) swap NUC encoders from stock to conservative NVENC profile 2) add automated NVR fallback test in CI 3) update runbook with RTMP bridge steps. tagging @eng_oncall and @samir to own follow-ups.

alex: calendar updated, agenda trimmed by 10m, Q&A slot extended by 5m to accommodate leadership time.

maria: thanks — rolling into the meeting now.

obs-bot: Stream status: live -> viewers=217 latency=1.2s; backup_nvr=recording; primary_obs=degraded (dropped_frames=1250).
